headline: 12 fire units rush as fire breaks out at Khulna City Medical College
summary: The blaze started on the ground floor of the 17-story building on Thursday night; fire service units worked for two hours to bring it under control.
details: A fire broke out at the private Khulna City Medical College Hospital on Thursday night around 9:33 PM.
According to fire service sources, units from the Khulna Sadar Fire Station were dispatched immediately after receiving the news at 9:35 PM.
Firefighters arrived at the scene by 9:40 PM and began operations to control the blaze.
Preliminary reports indicate that the fire originated on the ground floor of the 17-story hospital building.
A total of 12 units from the Khulna Sadar Fire Station were deployed to bring the fire under control.
The fire was brought under control after approximately two hours of effort by the firefighting teams.
The cause of the fire and the extent of the damages have not yet been officially disclosed.

headline_marked: 1 in 11 [[Bangladeshi children now in labour]], reports data
headline: 1 in 11 Bangladeshi children now in labour, reports data
summary: Experts and speakers emphasize that social responsibility is crucial to ending the exploitation of children in the workforce.
details: One in 11 children in Bangladesh are currently engaged in child labour, according to recent reports.
The statistic highlights a persistent challenge in protecting children's rights and ensuring their access to education.
During a recent discussion, speakers emphasized that social responsibility is key to eradicating child labour from the country.
They argued that collective action from society and the government is necessary to break the cycle of poverty and exploitation.
The focus remains on creating a sustainable environment where children can prioritize schooling over work.
